reason: Successor authorization for immutable Fast Closure V2 topology poisoning on implementation PR #566. The V1 authority and product scope remain valid, and independent exact-head review on 08108ce52c7eeb16fa59d51b9e74567015c69ea0 found one real P1: Ollama pull could report success when a 200 NDJSON stream ended without terminal status success. The root fix was implemented inside the already-authorized ollamaClient path, but a later regression commit c2dc9750de0cd8989ac67e45ea871f1034b05a43 introduced a new sibling WP0 test path outside the merged authorization. Fast Closure V2 validates every first-parent commit against the allowed path set, so deleting that file later cannot repair the published ancestry. V2 preserves the identical twenty-path implementation scope and identical two-path diagnostic scope, changes only to a unique successor implementation branch, and restarts from fresh trusted main without reusing poisoned ancestry.

supersedes.reason: PR #566 ancestry is immutable and contains published commit c2dc9750de0cd8989ac67e45ea871f1034b05a43 touching an implementation path outside the merged V1 authorization; descendant deletion cannot repair Fast Closure V2 per-commit path validation.

predecessorEvidence.independentReviewFinding: Ollama pull accepted a 200 NDJSON stream ending without terminal status success, allowing false completion after empty, malformed or truncated transfer output.
predecessorEvidence.rootFixBehavior: Require terminal status success before pull returns ok; otherwise fail closed with OLLAMA_PULL_INCOMPLETE.
predecessorEvidence.topologyFailure: Stage implementation-branch-policy rejects the immutable first-parent history even though the final diff returned to the authorized ten changed files.
predecessorEvidence.policyRootCause: Fast Closure V2 evaluates each first-parent commit after the authorization merge and rejects any commit whose changed paths escape the authorization. A descendant deletion cannot erase the earlier path violation.
predecessorEvidence.recoveryRule: Freeze PR #566 ancestry. No amend, force-push, rebase, policy weakening or descendant workaround. Recreate verified equivalent content only on the fresh successor lineage.

digestCanonicalization.pathNormalization: Require exact repository-relative normalized paths, remove duplicates, then sort with JavaScript default Array.prototype.sort().
digestCanonicalization.canonicalText: Join the normalized sorted unique path list with LF and append exactly one trailing LF before hashing.

expectedFailures: A verified local Ollama deployment is currently eligible for formal reply logical groups when its task tags match; the product contract requires formal quick/deep/director reply candidates to be cloud-only.
Current background AI jobs and formal reply jobs share the AiGateway Model Brain queue, so a slow local background execution can consume concurrency needed by interactive cloud work.
Ollama discovery exists but trusted main has no governed on-demand pull/progress/cancel lifecycle for approved local model assets.
Current status surfaces do not distinguish local auxiliary capability/benchmark/SLA evidence from real-time reply authority.
Trusted main does not fail closed with OLLAMA_PULL_INCOMPLETE when a 200 Ollama pull stream ends without terminal status success.

requiredProofs: Fresh trusted main still equals the successor authorization base before authorization merge; otherwise this proposal is stale and must be replaced by another fresh successor.
The successor implementation branch starts exactly from the effective ordinary two-parent successor authorization merge commit and contains no #566 poisoned ancestry.

The trusted implementationBranchPolicy parser recognizes the exact twenty-path implementation set, two-path Fast Closure V2 diagnostic scope, supersession edge and first-production evidence semantics.
The corrected diagnostic blobs are content-verified against the frozen #566 evidence before reuse; commit identities and ancestry are recreated fresh rather than cherry-picked as authority.
No active open PR mutates the authoritative Model Brain/local-model paths in this package.
The current Product/Desktop/Windows UAT candidate lineage and artifacts remain untouched.

local model qualification, allowedTasks and lifecycle projection

localAuxiliary.largeLowResourceModelRule: A large/quantized local model may be admitted only to background tasks whose measured SLA it satisfies; runnable does not imply real-time eligible.

forbiddenBehavior: Do not replace formal cloud reply with a local model because local hardware or a local model is available.
Do not make a formal reply wait for local inference, local model download, local benchmark or local runtime startup.
Do not silently downgrade reply quality to a smaller local model.
Do not treat HTTP 200 or stream EOF alone as a successful Ollama pull; terminal status success is required.
Do not implement a second physical model router or duplicate LiteLLM retry/fallback/provider-selection authority.
Do not add KTransformers, AirLLM, llama.cpp or another runtime in V1/V2 successor without fresh OSS-fit evidence and a merged same-work-package scope amendment.
Do not weaken Model Brain qualification, durable AI execution authority, stale-generation fencing or current reply evidence contracts.
